title: Alkali Metals Mod
description: Adds realistic, water-reactive alkali metals to Minecraft with full Tinkers' Construct and RF compatibility.
body:
# **AlkaliMetalsMod**
## What's This Mod?
Ever wanted to add a real-life science experiment to Minecraft? This mod adds all the alkali metals from the periodic table, which react realistically to rain and direct water contact. Each ingot—from Lithium to Cesium—can be obtained throughout the Overworld and smelted down into reactive ingots. In addition, Francium (one of the most reactive elements on the periodic table) can be found in the Nether. It reacts with the air instantly, eventually reaching its half-life and decaying into Astatine and Lead.
## IMPORTANT
- YOU NEED TO DOWNLOAD COFH CORE OR IT WILL CRASH!
## Features:
- 5 New Ingots: Highly reactive with water.
- 6 New Ores: Naturally generated throughout the world.
- Endgame Material: Rare resources found in the Nether.
- Power Generation: A machine that generates power from alkali metals.
- Mod Compatibility: Full Tinker's Construct integration.
